items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So they wanted me. Ernie Wilkins and all those guys were there. It was wonderful. The band was hot.

ctx.x: The guys I played with, they had a lot of soul. So they saw to it that I got the money back, and I went up to Wilberforce the next day. They already had a good drummer. So I then spent one semester there and went back, but I did manage to play drums there a little bit, that they had heard. About five months later they called me, because the drummer they had hired in my place was terrible. So they wanted me. Ernie Wilkins and all those guys were there. It was wonderful. The band was hot.
Okay. So you were being seen by some pretty important folks. You were on view.
